DECLARE @WProcessNo AS VARCHAR(56),@WPStepNo AS VARCHAR(56),@PhaseID AS VARCHAR(16),@JobSheetNo AS VARCHAR(56),
        @OrderSheetNo AS VARCHAR(56),@ProcessNo AS VARCHAR(16),@ProcessID AS VARCHAR(16),@Emp AS VARCHAR(16),
        @ClassID AS VARCHAR(16),@Shift AS VARCHAR(16),@StationID AS VARCHAR(16),@MachineID AS VARCHAR(16),
        @EndTime AS DATETIME,@CurrVats AS DECIMAL(3,1),@WorkQty AS DECIMAL(3,1),@EffiRate AS DECIMAL(3,1),
        @DyeProcessID AS VARCHAR(16),@RealValue AS DECIMAL(3,1),@ProgramID AS VARCHAR(16)


DECLARE mycursor CURSOR FOR SELECT a.JobSheetNo,a.SheetSeries,a.CreateDate,Value39,a.EmpID,CASE WHEN Value38='GX41'THEN 67 ELSE 68 END,Value38,
ClassID,e.ShiftID,'02',Value40,1,1,1,CASE WHEN Value38='GX41' THEN '933' ELSE '934' END,CASE WHEN Value38='GX41' THEN '加色' ELSE '返加色' END,1 
FROM dye.ProdTest a
INNER JOIN (SELECT c.ShiftID,ClassID,DeptID,EmpID FROM dye.p_Shift c
INNER JOIN dye.p_ShiftEmp d
ON c.ShiftID = d.ShiftID
WHERE StationID='02')e
ON ISNULL(a.EmpID,'') = e.EmpID
WHERE ISNULL(SheetKind,0)=7
AND a.SheetSeries=@SheetSeries

 FETCH NEXT FROM mycursor INTO @JobSheetNo,@OrderSheetNo,@EndTime,@MachineID,@Emp,@ProcessNo,@ProcessID,
                               @ClassID,@Shift,@StationID,@PhaseID,@CurrVats,@WorkQty,@EffiRate,@ProgramID,
                               @DyeProcessID,@RealValue
WHILE(@@fetch_status = 0)

BEGIN
  IF @PhaseID<>''
     BEGIN
       DELETE FROM dye.JobShiftEmp WHERE WProcessNo IN (SELECT WProcessNo FROM dye.WProcess WHERE OrderSheetNo=@SheetSeries)
